title: Spore becomes the starting tier
summary:
Spore joined the tier lineup, model defaults got one owner, and gateway authentication got a tune-up.

Spore was added ahead of Seed as the default tier for new accounts, with a badge in Enter and updated Pollen guidance. Subscription account matching was also corrected.

Chat completions now use the shared `openai` default when no model is specified. The text and image backends no longer silently substitute their own models; direct backend requests must provide a valid model.

Gateway-to-backend authentication configuration was aligned to address 403 responses. Proxy cleanup and more isolated text and audio tests accompanied the fix.
